CREATE TABLE t1(a, b COLLATE nocase)

CREATE VIEW v2 AS
    SELECT a,b,c FROM t1 INTERSECT SELECT a,b,b FROM t1
    WHERE 'eT"3qRkL+oJMJjQ9z0'>=b
